always_dark.title: Serial console always use dark theme

auto_scroll.title: Always scroll to the bottom on new content
auto_scroll.description: This will be turned on automatically when using debugger

show_snippet_editor.title: Show code snippet editor
show_snippet_editor.description: This is better for sending multiple lines of code to Python RELP

enter_to_send.title: In code snippet editor, Enter to send, Shift-Enter to make newline
enter_to_send.description: When not selected, the shortcuts will be reversed. This setting is applicable exclusively in code mode. In text mode, however, both shortcuts function to send text.

fresh_start_serial.title: Soft reboot after connected to serial.

data_serial_baud_rate.title: Data Serial Port baud rate
data_serial_baud_rate.description: Baud rate used when connecting to the Data Serial Port (usb_cdc.data or a separate USB serial device). The main Serial Console always uses 115200. Changing this only affects the next connection; reconnect the Data Serial Port to apply it.
